mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tb_product WHERE id = #{id} AND isDelete = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_product (name, description, price, placement, stock, categoryLevel1Id, categoryLevel2Id, categoryLevel3Id, fileName, createdBy, creationDate, approvalStatus) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{price}, #{placement}, #{stock}, #{categoryLevel1Id}, #{categoryLevel2Id}, #{categoryLevel3Id}, #{fileName}, #{createdBy}, #{creationDate}, #{approvalStatus})
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_product SET approvalStatus = #{status}, modifyDate = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tb_product WHERE approvalStatus = 1 AND isDelete = 0
